raster_policy.rule: Every generation starts at raster 1. Any technical failure in rasters 2-6 is handed to raster 1. Raster 1 diagnoses and applies only safe whitelisted infrastructure repairs, then the same generation restarts from raster 1 and proceeds again through raster 2 onward.

ordered_rasters.purpose: Keep the autonomous research loop healthy without enabling live trading or exchange secrets. Preserve research memory and ensure failures return to raster 1 instead of silently stopping.

Generate materially different challenger hypotheses from prior evidence. Optimize for the probability of turning 100 USDT into at least 200 USDT inside 10 days; do not favor low drawdown or sparse trading for their own sake.
Backtest and score repeatable 100-to-200 target hits across many independent 10-day windows. Reward useful micro-signals and high trade frequency when fees/slippage remain included.
Reject broken, incomplete, cherry-picked, look-ahead contaminated or non-reproducible evidence; do not reject merely because drawdown is high.
Measure drawdown, near-ruin and failure modes as learning evidence. In research these are diagnostics, not automatic vetoes, unless the result is technically invalid or unrealistically modeled.
Promote the challenger that improves the primary 100-to-200 hit-rate objective while remaining technically valid, checkpoint the evidence, and start the next generation at raster 1.

supervisor.name: TenDaySupervisor
supervisor.role: Research manager and sole promotion authority; prioritize target-hit probability over capital preservation

research_agent.name: ResearchAgent
research_agent.role: Generate materially different challenger hypotheses through deterministic Hyperopt search using training data only; learn from prior generations and avoid identical parameter fingerprints

operations_agent.name: OpsWatchdog
operations_agent.role: Raster 1 central recovery owner: keep research progressing, preserve checkpoints and research memory, diagnose later-raster failures, apply only whitelisted infrastructure repairs, and restart without user intervention

agents.name: QuantAgent
agents.role: Maximize repeatable >=200 USDT outcomes from 100 USDT in 10 days; use 150/175/250 thresholds and trade evidence as secondary learning signals

agents.name: ValidationCritic
agents.role: Reject incomplete, failed, cherry-picked, look-ahead contaminated or statistically unusable validation results

agents.name: RiskAgent
agents.role: Report drawdown, near-ruin and liquidation-style failure modes as research diagnostics without suppressing aggressive candidates solely for being risky

promotion.rule: No validation veto AND council score strictly exceeds current champion score; target_hit_rate is the dominant score component
